Columbus Friday Night Ride

Columbus, OH · Downtown

Columbus Friday Night Ride is a social group ride in Columbus, OH. It meets every Friday; meet 6:30 pm, roll 7:00 pm, starting at Topiary Park, Town St entrance. Expect about 10–15 miles, party pace, 10–12 mph.

About the Columbus Friday Night Ride group ride

A chill Friday social ride from Topiary Park with a playlist. Route and destination get decided by whoever shows up. Bring lights.
